lead.headline: Likely missed Friday, and covering him would still cost Jacobs
lead.deck: Nothing new by Saturday afternoon, so he starts. Daniels and Tuten are cleared. Taylor's 6.7 is final.
lead.body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely did not practise Friday (groin), and nothing newer has appeared by Saturday afternoon. The Giants gave him no game status and RotoBaller calls him good to go, so he starts. You carry no second tight end. Free-agent tight ends still play after 13:55, including Mike Gesicki on Monday night, but by then the only unlocked seats are Jacobs' and Golden's, and the call is still to take the zero rather than cut Jacobs before his likely Week 12 return. Daniels has no designation on Washington's Saturday report, and Tuten is cleared. The lineup as set is the projection lineup.
